about: Heart rate per set: the highest heart rate the watch measured around each set. Worked by hand from the rule in LIFT docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-28-build-plan.md item 16, on 2026-11-02. Checked into lift-ios (Swift) and dugcanlift-lift-watch (Kotlin). Never regenerate it from either port.
rule: Times are seconds. Only ticked sets get a figure; a set with no tick gets null and is not a neighbour to anyone.
Ticked sets are taken in tick order, whatever order they are listed in and whatever exercise they belong to.
A set's window ends at its tick + 20, or at the next tick in the session if that is sooner.

It starts at the previous tick in the session, or at sessionStart for the first set, but never earlier than tick - lookback, where lookback is 300, or durationSec + 30 when a set states a durationSec making that longer.
A sample of zero or below is not a reading. Samples need not be sorted.
The figure is the highest reading in the window, rounded to the nearest whole bpm, halves away from zero. A window with no reading is null: never zero, never a neighbour's figure, never interpolated.

cases.name: three sets, each window ending 20 s after its tick
a superset: the next tick comes before 20 s are up
the first set reaches back five minutes and no further
cases.worked: a: [300, 620] holds 130 125 140. The warm-up walk's 160, 150 and 158 are all before 300.

cases.name: both ends of a window are inclusive
cases.worked: a: [0, 80] holds 100 (at the start) 125 (at the tick) 130 (at the end); 180 at 80.5 is outside. b: [60, 220] holds 125 130 180 190 (at the end); 200 at 220.5 is outside.

cases.name: no reading in the window is no figure
cases.worked: a: [0, 80] holds nothing. b: [60, 140] holds 150. a is not given b's figure.

cases.name: zero is not a reading, and the figure rounds to a whole bpm
cases.worked: a: [0, 50] holds 0 141.5 -3; only 141.5 is a reading, and it rounds to 142. b: [30, 220] holds only the 0 at 190, which is not a reading. c: [200, 420] holds 99.49, which rounds to 99.

cases.name: a long timed set reaches back further; a short one does not
cases.worked: a: lookback is 600 + 30 = 630, so [270, 920] holds 150 140; 170 at 260 is outside. b: 60 + 30 is shorter than 300, so lookback is 300 and the previous tick, 900, is later than 700: [900, 1020] holds 135.

cases.name: sets listed out of order, one never ticked
cases.worked: In tick order: a at 50, c at 200. a: [0, 70] holds 130 135. c: [50, 220] holds 135 150 160. b has no tick, so no figure, and it does not cut a's or c's window.

cases.name: the session's start bounds the first set
cases.worked: a: the session started at 1000, later than 1030 - 300, so [1000, 1050] holds 120; 170 at 990 was before the session.
